column1: # scripts/known-deviations.issues.tsv — the issues the known deviations name, with the rule each one
# does not meet and the observable difference (#1126 S2).
# Columns, TAB-separated: issue number, rule not met (spec chapter and section, or decision ID),
# observable difference, and `rows` when scripts/known-deviations.tsv names it or `none` when the
# deviation has no fixture row: no program-visible value differs (the defect is in how the result is
# reached), or the pinned revision's rule is not implemented yet and its issue carries the reproduction.
# Every issue here must be open: scripts/land.sh PHASE 2 refuses a closed one, and
# `scripts/fixture_expect.sh --issues-open` asks `gh` by hand. The gate holds the rest without network.
